info.name: AI Trading Platform API
info.description:
# AI Trading Platform – REST API

Backend of the AI trading analysis platform (FastAPI, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, Redis, Celery). This collection covers **every endpoint** (78 requests) with a saved example response for each request and its main error cases.

**Synced with backend commit `1891bd6`** of `main`. Interactive OpenAPI docs: `{{base_url}}/docs`.

## Quick start

1. Import the collection and both files of `docs/postman/environments/`.
2. Pick an environment (**Production (VPS)** or **Local (Docker)**) and fill in `user_email` / `user_password` (and `admin_email` / `admin_password` for the Admin folder).
3. Send any request. Tokens are obtained, cached and refreshed automatically by the collection's pre-request script; you never paste a token by hand.

No account yet? Send **Auth → Register**: when `user_email` is empty, the new account becomes the collection's user.

## Authentication

| Method | How | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| Bearer JWT | `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` (collection default) | apps, everything |
| Admin JWT | `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}` (Admin folder) | `/admin/*` |
| API key | `X-API-Key: {{api_key}}` | external programs, read-only scopes |

Access tokens live 30 minutes, refresh tokens 14 days and are rotated on every refresh. Roles: `trader` (default on registration), `analyst`, `expert`, `admin`.

## Conventions

* Base path `/api/v1`; JSON in and out; all times are **UTC** (naive datetimes are taken as UTC).
* Chart data uses **unix seconds** in `time` (Lightweight Charts format).
* Lists are pages: `{"items": [...], "total": 123, "limit": 20, "offset": 0}`.
* Errors: `{"detail": "message"}`, or for validation (422) `{"detail": [{"loc": ["body", "field"], "msg": "...", "type": "..."}]}`.
* Someone else's resource answers **404**, never 403.

## Rate limits

Per identity (user, or each API key) per minute: trader 60, analyst/expert 300, admin 1,000. Indicator computation, strategy preview and backtest creation cost 5. Every limited response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`; a 429 adds `Retry-After`.

## Running the whole collection

The folders are ordered so the **Collection Runner** can execute them top to bottom: each folder creates what it needs (workspaces, strategies, backtests, keys), uses it and deletes it again. Ids are passed between requests through environment variables (`instrument_id`, `workspace_id`, `backtest_id`, …). Every request has tests for its status code and documented fields.

> On **Production**, Register, Admin and the create requests write real data. Prefer the Local environment for full runs.

## Folders

Health · Auth · Users (me) · Market Data · Indicators · Strategies & Signals · Risk Management · Custom Strategies · Backtests · Workspaces · API Keys · Admin · Realtime (WebSocket)

Maintained in the repository: `docs/postman/` (generated by `docs/postman/tools/`).

item.name: 02 · Auth
item.description:
Registration and JWT sessions.

* **Access token**: short lived (`expires_in` seconds, 30 min by default), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
* **Refresh token**: 14 days, **rotated** on every refresh (the old one stops working).
* API keys are always refused here (403).

**Per-IP limits** on top of the normal rate limit: login 10/min (and 5/min per e-mail), register 5/min, refresh 30/min. 10 failed logins for one e-mail within 15 min lock that e-mail for 15 min.

> You rarely need to call Login yourself: the collection's pre-request script logs in with `user_email` / `user_password` and refreshes the token automatically.

item.name: 04 · Market Data
item.description:
Instruments and OHLCV candles from TimescaleDB (1m hypertable + continuous aggregates for 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d).

* JWT, or an API key with the `market:read` scope.
* Candle `time` is the bucket start in **unix seconds (UTC)**: the format Lightweight Charts expects (`series.setData(candles)`).
* Naive datetimes in queries are taken as UTC.

item.description:
The shared technical-indicator library (`libs/indicators`): the same code runs in the API, the backtester and the live signal engine.

|---|---|
| `market:read` | instruments, candles |
| `indicators:read` | indicator catalog + compute |
| `strategies:read` | strategy catalog + preview, custom-strategy schema + public list |
| `signals:read` | `GET /signals` |
| `stream` | WebSocket `/ws/market` |
| `backtests:read` | reading your backtests |

Active keys per account: trader 2, analyst/expert 5, admin 10. Each key has its own rate-limit bucket.
